handoff.salientSummary: User testing for end-to-end milestone completed. 6/10 assertions passed, 4 failed. K8s Jobs not being created - critical blocker. Results pagination, cancellation, and API key security all working.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: User testing validation for end-to-end milestone. Spawned 5 flow validator subagents to test VAL-CROSS-001 through VAL-CROSS-010. Found that K8s Job creation is not working (evaluations stay pending), but result persistence, cancellation, API key security, concurrency isolation, and pagination all work correctly.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: Full lifecycle test (VAL-CROSS-001, VAL-CROSS-002) and high load test (VAL-CROSS-010) could not complete because K8s Jobs are not being created. Error propagation test (VAL-CROSS-005) blocked because no failed evaluations exist.

discoveredIssues.description: K8s Jobs are not being created when evaluations are created via POST /api/v1/evaluations. API creates DB records with status=pending but never spawns K8s Jobs in llm-eval namespace. Evaluations remain stuck in 'pending' state indefinitely.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Check the StartEvaluation goroutine in evaluation handler - it may be failing silently or not being triggered. Verify orchestrator.StartEvaluation is being called and K8s client is properly configured.

discoveredIssues.description: No failed evaluations exist to test VAL-CROSS-005 (error propagation). System has error_message column and infrastructure for failure handling, but no failures have occurred.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: This is not a code issue - simply no failed evaluations have been created yet. Error propagation infrastructure is in place.
